config.data_status: SYNTHETIC DATA — constructed demonstration, not results from real agents
config.description: A deliberately constructed online-memory simulator. A task is scored before its update is considered. Valid records raise success probability; invalid records lower it. Verified policies check proposals with a fallible checker. Only verified keeps a bounded rejection-signature ledger. The ledger consumes the same total configured memory budget. Policies and budgets share the exact scenario stream and random variates within each seed/family. The no-memory policy ignores its assigned memory capacity and is exactly identical across budgets.

primary_estimand: Mean over independent seed blocks of the within-seed equal-weight mean over the 4 fixed task families and 4 fixed budgets of verified minus unfiltered success, in percentage points.
interval_method: Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap, 20,000 draws, resampling all 24 matched seed blocks as intact clusters; no family/episode resampling; no multiplicity adjustment.
